description: This file defines the main front-end page component for the smart notes application, implementing note listing, creation, deletion, editing, tagging, and autosave functionalities using React hooks and components.

methods.name: formatListDate
methods.description: Formats ISO date strings into a human-readable local date string.

methods.name: deriveTitle
methods.description: Derives a note title from its content or provides a default.

methods.name: normalizeTags
methods.description: Normalizes and de-duplicates a comma-separated string of tags.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of notes from the API, optionally filtering by a search query.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new blank note and adds it to the list.

methods.name: deleteSelected
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note after confirmation.

methods.name: debouncedAutosave
methods.description: Debounced function to autosave the current note draft.

methods.name: updateDraftAndAutosave
methods.description: Updates the draft state and triggers autosave if applicable.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a tag from the current note.
